name: Birds: SkySea’s End
summary:
Still developing，Below is the next section.
Hatch from your egg 🥚 and embark on an unforgettable journey as a baby bird 🐤.
Grow quickly in just 3–6 minutes by eating roasted food 🍗, fruits 🍎, and fish 🐟 to evolve into a fully-feathered flying bird 🕊️.
Explore a breathtaking 3-layer world with glowing sea creatures ✨, flying squid 🦑, and colossal sea monsters 🐠.
Be careful: death turns you into roasted chicken 🍗! Other players can eat you to gain evolution points ⚡🤣.
